subject: Taxes
title: Procedural Justice in Taxation
description: A 60-second lesson on Procedural Justice in Taxation.

hook.text: People accept unfavorable outcomes if the process feels fair.

buildup.text: Procedural justice theory says how decisions are made matters as much as what is decided.

discovery.text: Australia's Tax Office found taxpayers treated well during audits were 40% more likely to comply in future years.

twist.text: Adversarial audits—the 'gotcha' approach—actually reduce long-term compliance.

climax.text: The IRS's reputation for intimidation may cost more revenue than it collects.

punchline.text: Treat taxpayers fairly and they pay more. Respect outperforms intimidation.

quiz.question: What did the Australian Tax Office find about respectful audits?
options: Taxpayers were 40% more likely to comply in future years
